name: 25337-visionchat-qwen3vl-4b-1gpu
model: Qwen/Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct. Public, ungated, image-text-to-text, 8.9 GB of safetensors.
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1).
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, one in-process vLLM engine. A 4B model fits one card.
load_profile: poisson (open loop, rate-capped), rate=[24, 12, 18, 30, 36] req/s, warmup 10%, cooldown 10%, bounded at 1000 requests per rate with a 900 s safety cap. The first entry is the operating point and is what benchmarks[0] scores; the other four bracket it so the knee can be located.
workload: single-turn image chat: one 1024x768 JPEG (seed 42, guidellm default content) plus a ~94-token question per request, 121 output tokens. Image and prompt are distinct per request.
purpose: A compact 4B photo question-answering assistant, one image and brief question per request, up to 36 per second, one GPU.
launch:
model: Qwen/Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct
tensor-parallel-size: 1
dtype: bfloat16

# Written out, not inherited: an in-process engine is built under UsageContext.ENGINE_CONTEXT and
# would fall through to the library default of 2048 batched tokens instead of these.
max-num-batched-tokens: 8192
max-num-seqs: 1024

gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
enable-prefix-caching: true
max-model-len: 8192
